title: Internal Event Ledger
user: A solo developer or small product team that needs to review non-urgent operational events without letting them disappear inside Slack channels.
smallest_useful_product: Self-hosted receiver with endpoint aliases, event fingerprints, searchable timeline, acknowledge/archive state, daily digest, and JSON/CSV export.
success_measure: A pilot routes at least five sources through it and reduces unread operational Slack messages by 50% while retaining a searchable record for 30 days.
constraints: Verify signatures where supported; redact configured headers/body paths; provide retention deletion and a simple Docker deployment.
